snapshot.kind: full-fidelity snapshot of the restored production copy, built by the branch binary

engine.note: T5 (kata) landed on issue/526-u5a on 2026-11-22 but is not deployed; the snapshot is a read-only projection of the restored production copy, so this is the pre-transition baseline.

definition.accepted_deliverable: a published output document attached to a project: artefacts.json.documents entry with publishable=true
definition.window: all tenant inference calls and all publishable outputs present in the snapshot
definition.attribution: portfolio-level ratio, not a per-run causal attribution; project_id attribution exists for only 3 projects and card_id for 5 cards, so the ratio is not a complete per-project cost

comparison_basis.unit: tokens per published output, portfolio-level; cost is secondary because 81 calls are unpriced
comparison_basis.post_transition: same tenant, same definition, a window at least as long as the baseline window, measured from the inference ledger and the published outputs at the post-transition revision
comparison_basis.secondary: run failure rate and tokens per succeeded run, to expose whether a per-deliverable improvement is bought by rejecting more work

target.note: the target is not yet a live row; U6 records it on the benefit profile at the same measured_at as this baseline

caveats: 366 of 371 runs failed (98.65%); the token spend is dominated by failed runs, so 65,231 tokens per output is a ceiling, not an efficient cost.
The frozen a33e6562 pack reported 165 outputs; the fresh snapshot reports 145. The fresh snapshot is authoritative; the pack's outputs projection was incomplete.
Only 2 runs succeeded and 1 approval exists; the accepted-deliverable count is the published outputs, not approved cards.
The six live benefit profiles all say 'not measured - no instrument exists'; the token KPI is not yet one of them, so U6 must add or amend a profile before this baseline can be marked measured.
The benefit row and this file must keep the same measured_at; the lane owner will announce the row date.
